Biological Absorption

Alex Mercer (Prototype) consuming Elizabeth Greene.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb biomass.

The ability to absorb biomass and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of Biological Manipulation and Organic Manipulation. Variation of Organic Absorption.

Also Called[]

  • Biological Assimilation
  • Biomass Absorption/Assimilation
  • Tissue Absorption/Assimilation

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb biological mass/matter, while removing it from the source, into their body and use it in various ways, gaining some form of advantage, either by enhancing themselves, gaining the drained power, knowledge, skills, etc., using it as power source etc., either temporarily or permanently.

Applications[]

  • Assimilation Shield
  • Adoptive Muscle Memory
  • DNA Absorption
  • Knowledge/Memory Absorption
  • Life-Force Absorption
  • Linguistic Assimilation
  • Organic Empowerment
  • Organic Regeneration
  • Peak Human/Enhanced/Supernatural Condition
  • Superpower Absorption

Techniques[]

  • Consumption Shapeshifting
  • Consumptive Growth
  • Consumptive Learning

Variations[]

  • Flesh Absorption
  • Technological Assimilation

Associations[]

  • Absorptive Merging
  • Animal Morphing
  • Biological Manipulation
  • Biomass Manipulation
  • Consumptive Replication
  • Genetic Memory
  • Life-Force Absorption
  • Matter Absorption
  • Organic Absorption
  • Organic Manipulation

Limitations[]

  • If the target's body contains something the user is vulnerable to, they are essentially absorbing it directly.
  • Anti Storage users are immune to this power (if it tries to keep them sealed/separate from/alive within the absorber).
  • May be limited to how much one can absorb.
  • May have a limited range, including touch only.
  • May have unwanted side-effects.
  • May be limited on how much or how long the ability will last.
  • May need to literally absorb the target, or at sizable least part of them.
  • May need an object/technique to control their abilities.
  • May not be able to reverse the process.
  • Absorption Immunity/Absorption Negation
  • Those who are absorbed might still be alive/conscious, therefor they might take control over the user's body or harm them from within.
